verdict.rationale: Make provides 'Skills' Markdown files that help AI assistants (e.g., Claude) 'reliably perform Make-specific tasks, including building scenarios, configuring modules' via its MCP server, and the MCP server lets AI systems 'view and modify scenarios' — evidence of NL-driven workflow generation/editing through an AI client rather than a native in-app prompt-to-workflow feature. missing for 10: a first-party in-product UI where a user types a prompt and Make itself generates/edits the scenario, and any hands-on demonstration of this working end-to-end.
